arc.mood: Fresh off the road. Loud on purpose.
arc.lookingFor: Someone who stays. Says it's a business partner for a brewery. It isn't.
arc.wanted: WANTED: partner for a brewery that doesn't exist yet. Must tolerate noise, smoke, and questions about where you're from. Dwarves need not apply, probably. Inquire at any loud room.
arc.beat: Two days to the doors. Nothing owed, nobody met. Decide what he takes apart when a room goes quiet; something that fits a pocket. Then find the loudest table in Ironforge and ask who is furthest from home.

posts.title: Launch day
posts.text: Doors open. Just got into town. Nothing's exploded yet. Give it a week.
posts.detail: Already asked three people where they're from.
